Canvas.ReferenceDisplayHint.zh: 以当前格长和横纵数量，在主屏中心重置透视；网格与非透视模式重合。
Canvas.ReferenceDisplayHint.en: Reset perspective at the primary-screen center using the current cell size and counts, matching the flat grid.

Canvas.MultiMonitorHelp.zh: 拖动中央把手可将透视框整体移动到其他屏幕；重置统一回到主屏中心，使网格与非透视模式重合。
Canvas.MultiMonitorHelp.en: Drag the central handle to move the perspective frame to another display. Reset returns it to the primary-screen center so the grid matches flat mode.

Canvas.DragBoundary.zh: 已到达透视边界；拖动中央把手可整体移动。
Canvas.DragBoundary.en: Perspective limit reached. Drag the center handle to move the canvas.
